sentences.text: The Gold Loan FAQ describes gold loans, borrowing limits, and tenure, but it does not state any pre-payment charge percentage.
For UCB loans outside the specific cases in paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, are to be set as per the approved policy of the UCB.
I could not find a gold-loan-specific pre-payment percentage in the Gold Loan FAQ, and the other bank documents on record give different pre-payment charge figures for other loan products.

missing.searched: Searched the Gold Loan FAQ for any pre-payment charge percentage and found none; also checked the bank’s other loan documents, which contain pre-payment charges for home loans, MSE loans, and the UCB Directions but not a gold-loan-specific percentage.
